name: Honda Africa Twin XRV650 / XRV750
engine: 647 or 742 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, two carbs
intro: The original Africa Twin. A rally-styled V-twin with two carbs, a big tank and a lot of bodywork to remove for any job.

F: Check the regulator/rectifier and its connector. A failed regulator is a well-known problem on these.

recallNote: Most of these were sold new outside the US, so the NHTSA search may not cover them. Ask a Honda dealer to check the frame number.
